title: Proxy Gallery

services.name: Current Exhibition
services.desc: During awakening, [ PROXY ] invites visitors to encounter themselves within the works. The exhibition shines a light on both inner and outer worlds while engaging themes of the exoteric, epiphany, and enlightenment. In doing so, it reveals [ PROXY ]’s broader mission: to elevate dialogue and cultivate expansive cultural conversations. [ PROXY ] sets out as a new kind of third place; an artful space that fosters exploration, contemplation, and joy. awakening is an ode to expansion, nurtured by the interplay of light and darkness. Bringing together artists who dream in tessellations of luminosity, texture, and geometry, the exhibition reveals compositions that seem to pulse beyond the surface
